The '''Thyrsian pike''' was a type of [[Pike/Legends|pike]] used by the [[Sun Guard]]. The [[Force pike/Legends|force]] and [[solar pike]]s were variants of this weapon.<ref name="Ancient Coruscant">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-2-ancient-coruscant|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 2 - Ancient Coruscant}}</ref>
